name: Idle Tank
author: Addicting Games
description: Idle Tank is a free idle game. Idle games are sure to blow your mind like the blast of a tank shell! We're talking about the all-new, free-to-play, action-packed idle game taking the gaming world by storm: Idle Tank! In this game, you'll take command of a mighty tank charged with blasting your way through numbered barriers that stand in your path. Each obstacle has a different number, and you'll need to shoot it enough times to reduce that number to zero. It sounds easy, right? Think again! But fear not, gamer friends, because, in Idle Tank, you're constantly upgrading your tank to make it stronger and deadlier. Want to dodge incoming fire? Upgrade your tank's speed! Want to deal more damage with each shot? Upgrade your turret! The possibilities are endless, and the power is in your hands. All you have to do is point, click, and blast.  Let's not forget about the graphics, which are as explosive and minimal as the tanks themselves! With stunning flat retro animations and vivid, colorful explosions, you'll feel like you're in the middle of a battlefield, tapping, clicking, and idly blasting your way to victory. The best part of Idle Tank is that it's free to play! That's right; you can start playing without spending a single penny. Get ready to blast through blockades, upgrade your tank, and conquer the battlefield in Idle Tank, the most explosive idle game around.
